pokedexEntries.go: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.

pokedexEntries.si: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its BITE is powerful.

pokedexEntries.cr: It can make most any POKéMON run away simply by opening its mouth wide to reveal its big fangs.

pokedexEntries.rs: GRANBULL has a particularly well-developed lower jaw. The enormous fangs are heavy, causing the POKéMON to tip its head back for balance. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite indiscriminately.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.

pokedexEntries.su: Its well-developed lower jaw and heavy fangs are its weapons. As long as it’s not provoked, it rarely bites.

pokedexEntries.mo: More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted on by young people amused at the contrast between its looks and its attitude.

pokedexEntries.us: While it has powerful jaws, it doesn’t care for disputes, so it rarely has a chance to display their might.

pokedexEntries.um: Although it’s popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it’s totally incompetent as a watchdog.
